part2_cosmos_v7.note: v7 keyframes are 8 frames evenly spaced over the WHOLE episode, so their timing depends on the (future) episode length: successes are sampled ~3x denser than failures. History rules (vis_nohold, vis_drop) are therefore optimistically biased; the snapshot rule uses only the single latest keyframe <= T at failure-keyframe times, which is approximately time-matched.
